blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-01. The Terms of Service dated 27 August 2026 explicitly state that Unipay does not have or claim the ability to freeze, burn, seize, or otherwise alter USDu or sUSDu held in a user's wallet; interface suspension is separate. This supersedes the adverse issuer-legal-power claim recorded by the 2026-08-08 review. Verified BSC USDu.sol has standard ERC-20 holder transfers, self/allowance-based burning, and owner-only minter replacement, with no holder blacklist, seizure, or pause surface. At finalized Solana slot 452213018, both RPC reads returned no freezeAuthority and only metadataPointer/tokenMetadata extensions. The still-active Solana mint authority and BSC issuance-admin powers remain Mint Authority risks rather than holder-freeze powers.

oracleRisk.summary: USDu is issued against a protocol-managed delta-neutral reserve portfolio rather than borrower debt positions with oracle-triggered collateral liquidation.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: Unitas's protocol-managed delta-neutral portfolio uses collateral and hedge marks to monitor margin, PnL, exposure, and liquidity, with bots rebalancing hedge sizes about hourly to keep net exposure aligned. Those internal market-value inputs affect the top-level redemption and reserve operation; USDu has no borrower-specific debt or liquidation branches, so the disposition is top-level-only.
